title: Blood Type Supply Runs From Rare AB-Negative To Common O-Positive
hook: Blood supply depends on both rare types and who shows up to donate.
closing: Knowing your blood type helps explain where the donor supply is strongest or thinnest.
question: Do you know your blood type?

segments.say: AB-negative represents just 1% of the population. It sits at the rarest edge of the blood type distribution.
Rh-negative blood represents 15% of the population. Negative types draw from a much smaller donor pool.
O-positive reaches 53% among Latin American donors. Donor background helps shape the available blood supply.
